title: The Writing Turned to the Sleeve

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The slate goes down the bridge road with its writing turned to the sleeve, and the figure goes up the clay road in a box with no key. Neither stops for a house to say what it carries.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and fourteen to four hundred and sixteen days, six months and two hundred and thirty-four to two hundred and thirty-six days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 413 exact at the opening on answer 402, closing at 416 exact on answer 408. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting, and the yard well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Ilmen 20 (Day 414) is the month's second Account-day and market, earned by its own morning and not brought into a day that had not earned it; Ilmen 30 (Day 424), the third and last reading, stands eight mornings beyond the close, a date and not a day earned. The chapter opens in the small hours of Ilmen 20 with the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 402 and the count exact at 413, the soft-cuffed clerk's entered figure kept on its own place with a finger between it and Tarn's degree and another between it and the face at the yard's edge, the fifth shaping of the well-saying found where put on its own tray, Tarn's withheld sentence found where put and not made a habit, the softening at the river's skin kept as weather, the first arithmetic of Y.H. 814 up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box with no key under any roof and not laid across the twelve of Y.H. 813, and two readings not yet standing behind one another and not made one account. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and gone past the point where a child would still eat it, the empty place beside it holding the fold found where put and still a finding, not a placing, the thread of drool stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the surgeon's rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for is checked by the infant's three wants, the crust lifted, the thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work.
places: the flat stone by the well
the reading block under the moot-post
the moot-post's finger's width of shade

scenes.title: The Twentieth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{414}{Ilmen 20, Y.H. 814, Tenthday}: the small hours opening on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 402 and the count exact at 413, then first light, the carrying-down at the half-pace, and Ilmen's second Account-day at the Cross. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Berr Clay come up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded under his coat, Hessa Rale carrying the slate up the road before noon with the writing to her sleeve, the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge with his inward slate and entered figure on its own place; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons at the market's ordinary grammar (eight pigs over the wet boards, figures brought to a heap of turnips and left standing side by side, a bell struck through the morning, nobody crossing himself). No man from Slate Row on stage, no collector called, no second well-telling, no eighth green at the pot board and no eighth shape at the market's edge, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 19's weather crosses into the reading as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 30 stands eight mornings off, a date and not a day earned. Dramatic purpose: Berr wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing, holds the narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passes a finger over the figure, reads *One in twelve, as the notice says* twice over the basket — once for the moot and once for the households that came late — calls the levy, denies it with *your house*, never *I*, sends a man with a number in a shut fist to a slate at the watch and goes off up the clay road with the box locked and Ilmen's second true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness, his low saying about kindness entered on a place of its own with no payer standing (T015/T041/T047, T077 advanced, not paid). Two readings of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure — two are two and not one account, the first is not made a thirteenth by the second, the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of two — and the twelve old arithmetics are not laid across them to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer and no key came under any roof (T015/T041/T047 held apart from T100, T061/T082). Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lies and stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, carries him home at the going of the light and says nothing (T058/T079). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told and its gap not folded into the fire's gap, the boards' gap or the two figures — three counts in three places staying three, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood (T078, T061/T082). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the face at the yard's edge stay on three places with a finger between every pair; the fifth shaping stays on its own tray; Tarn's withheld sentence stays found where put and not made a habit; the softening under the river's skin stays weather and is not spent on a reading (T090/T080, T036/T076, T083/T085/T092). Answer **403** comes out on the sixth place: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer.

scenes.title: What the Twentieth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 20 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 404 and the count at 414 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-four days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar after the market (pail on its stone, rope settling into its knot, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure, barley passed wall to wall and never made into a number). The man from Slate Row is not on stage, the clerk is not a sighting, no second well-telling comes, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, eighth opening or tenth hand stands and no slate is opened within reach of the basket. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, and keeps the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a figure rises out of a shut fist toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve; a woman sent to ask what a pot cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and the arithmetic read over it that morning did not know what it cost and no signature stands on the space between (T077). Nothing from the second reading crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; Berr's low saying and *your house* stay on places of their own and his belief in the kindness stays up the road with the box where it went (T041/T047). At the going of the light she keeps the whole hearth grammar — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air — lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the tighter wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing, gives both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carries him up the nineteen steps at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven places, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, rights the fold without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs because a market, a reading, a shelf, a yard and a going of the light are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth came due on a day that earned its twentieth (T058/T079/T100). In the small hours the towel comes out and he goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's four and a gap, the boards' four and four and a knot, or the two arithmetics behind one unsigned figure beside the twelve old ones (T061/T082, T078, T088, T081); nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the face on three places; the fifth shaping on its own tray; Hessa's eighth and Ilva's ninth held with no tenth (T080/T090). Answer **404** filed, exact, complete, worth nothing. The hand goes up the inch toward the river's note, the inch not a reach, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lies flat against the fold.

scenes.title: The Man with the Slate
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{415}{Ilmen 21, Y.H. 814, Firstday}: the small hours opening the day, first light and the morning work, and the chapter's plant on the Firstday morning. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Ilva glimpsed once at the yard well with her hand to her sleeve and the strip unread, her ninth hand nine, expressly not the speaker of any word; Garl Vail in objects only. A second man from Slate Row, this one with a narrow slate under his arm and the writing turned toward his sleeve, goes down the north bridge road before first grey without a word that carries; he is a seen shape with no sheet, no name, no errand, no interior, no witness's standing and no sale; no figure comes off the slate and no room is entered. No Berr, Hessa sighting, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; the first man from Slate Row's face is not on stage, the clerk stays reported at the landing, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand or eleventh arithmetic and no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 20's reading crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust gone leathery past the point where a child would still eat it, fold found where put, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at the small bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid: the boy takes the second man's passing apart by the order of its parts — the slate under the arm, the writing turned away, the direction down the bridge road, the word that does not carry — and files the direction and the slate on places of their own beside the first man's face, the clerk's entered figure and the fifth shaping, with a finger between every pair (T080/T090 advanced, NOT paid; a new reaching held for the far-off calling of the loan that can hear). He gives no name, no owner, no answer carried, no interior, no witness's standing and no joining to Tarn's valuable ear, Tarn's ended term, the clerk's entered figure, the face at the yard's edge or Jorra's ungiven promise; it is a shape gathering interest toward a far-off hand, not a sale, not a tenth hand, not a rule, not the calling of the loan, not a sixth shaping of the well-saying, and no second man's word was heard. Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, his hand over blade and sill and away and the sentence found where put, not repeated as a custom and not made a tenth stopping; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person and takes his finger from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T036/T076 held, T062/T035/T031 held). Answer **405** filed on the sixth place, six honest answers begun on the new tend, not one a doctrine.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-first Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 21 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 406 and the count at 415 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-five days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve. Walk-ons at the ordinary Firstday grammar. The second man from Slate Row is not on stage again, his direction and his slate stay where put and are not repeated or made a rule; no word comes up at the well that he asked after a house-name, no collector comes up or down the clay road, and no sixth of anything stands. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the small sounds first and goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place; the called-gone grey stays beside the left-in-place ridge with a finger between, and the clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw stays unswept and unowned (T009/T013/T092, T098). At the Vail corner the sour tang of Ash is thinner in the air that came off the river on the nineteenth and the grey lies a hair less distinct along one stretch; the boy finds the softening where put and does not look twice, for looking twice is how a finding becomes a habit, and does not make it a sign, a fourth covering or a payment on a day that earned only its twenty-first (T083/T085/T092 held, advanced and not paid). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather: a number in a shut fist goes from fist toward the well and back into a sleeve and arrives nowhere; a woman sent to ask what a pot cost is sent to the pot and gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no signature between the figure and the price (T077). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge, the first man's face and the second man's direction and slate are kept on separate places with a finger between every pair, and no joining or witness stands under any of them (T080/T090). At the going of the light the whole hearth grammar holds with the pot's hairline showing, both proverbs to pot and fire, the grain unfigured, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, the widow's mark untouched and no eighth opening (T058/T079/T100). In the small hours the towel comes out: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the carried fire's four pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and fifteen days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two standing side by side without becoming one (T088, T061/T082); three counts in three places staying three; nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the fifth shaping on its own tray and the softening kept as weather (T078, T081, T080, T083/T085). Answer **406** filed. The hand goes up the inch, holds the interval whole on the river's note under its covering, lets it go on the note's own finishing and comes straight down on the fold.

scenes.title: The Twenty-second Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{416}{Ilmen 22, Y.H. 814, Secondday}: the small hours opening the day with the hand laid down on answer 406 and the count exact at 415, then first light and the morning work, with answer 407 and the count reaching 416 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-six days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Ilva glimpsed once at the yard well or kept offstage with the strip unread and her ninth hand nine; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons at the ordinary Secondday grammar. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no second asking at the well, no repetition of the second man's direction, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 21 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 30 stands eight mornings off and is not brought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order, the crust leathery and hardened through the dry nights into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put and still a finding, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, knowing a basket set level out of the draught where heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and sixteen exact against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped, and does not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure, and does not lay the twelve old arithmetics or the two readings of the year across one another to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer and no key lies in his hand (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket at both ends of the day, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the unread charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row with neither gap figured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to the pot and the fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven places, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, rights the fold without a second fold; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs because a morning, a shelf, a yard and a bed are not openings (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife on its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach; the sentence is found where put and not made a habit and the silence of the eighteenth is not repeated on an unearned day (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra's grey dust, the wheel spoken to before any person, the damper's two bites and the withheld note hold, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). Answer **407** filed on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing.

scenes.title: The Writing Kept Where Put
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 22 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 408 and the count at 416 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-six days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at kindling and flagstones with the eighteenth's silence held; Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper; Ilva with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's slate unread up the road with her eighth hand eighth; Berr up the clay road with the box locked, the two readings of the year and the low saying about kindness inside; the clerk's inward slate and entered figure reported at the out-of-line landing; the first man from Slate Row's face and the second man's narrow slate with its writing turned to the sleeve and his direction down the north bridge road on their own places with a finger between every pair; the fifth shaping of the well-saying on its own tray; the softening at the river's skin kept as weather; the green at the pot board and the shape at the market's edge as sightings with no eighth. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second well-telling, no market, no collector, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place, and keeps the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a figure in a fist goes toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve; a woman sent to ask what a pot cost gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and the two readings of the year read over it in their own mornings did not know what it cost (T077). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water under its winter skin, softer at one edge where the low note ran nearer on the nineteenth, found where put and not made a sign or spent on a tend-day (T083/T085/T092). At the going of the light the whole hearth grammar holds with repair kept apart from restoration — the twice-mended pot's hairline left showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, the grain unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092). In the small hours the towel comes out as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and he goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: the clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree and the face on three places; the first man's face and the second man's slate and direction on their own places with a finger between every pair and no name, owner, answer, sale, witness, tenth hand or rule under any of them, a reaching gathering interest toward the far-off calling (T080/T090 advanced, not paid); the fifth shaping on its own tray between Hessa's eighth hand and the road saying with a third finger between it and the four ownerless directions; Tarn's withheld sentence found where put and not made a habit; the softening at the river's skin found where put and not made a sign; Berr's low saying about kindness entered on a place of its own with no payer standing; the twelve old arithmetics behind one unsigned figure beside the first and second readings of the year, two readings two and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of two (T015/T041/T047); six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's gap, the boards' knot or the two readings — three counts in three places staying three, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood (T078, T061/T082, T081); nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the carried fire's four pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and sixteen days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the fire and the man standing side by side without becoming one (T088). Answer **408** filed on the sixth place: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the first and second of the new count, the printed figure, the fifth shaping, the clerk's entered figure, the second man's slate, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge, Jorra's ungiven promise, the withheld sentence, the softening, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the winter skin, the widow's mark nor the keeping at the fold. Six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 403 through 408, and not one is a doctrine. The surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side with neither buying the other; the hand comes up an inch toward the river's note, the inch not a reach, takes the small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ends — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. A voice in a yard would be a voice in a yard and not a door; the second man's direction and the slate turned to the sleeve are kept where put and not called. Nothing has been joined, named, called, paid or ended, and the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into Ilmen 23, a morning not yet earned and not brought into this one.
